widgets_values:
TEST: Load Image (Filename) -> Save Image.

The filename output feeds Save Image's filename_prefix, so the saved file's name IS the node's output. Upload an input whose name has a newline, ':' or '/' and a trailing counter, e.g. 'weird:slot_001.png'.

Regex (prefilled pattern '_+\d+_*', empty replacement): strips a trailing counter, slot_001 -> slot. Full rename: pattern '^.*$' + new name. Groups: pattern '(\d+)' -> replacement '[\1]'. Sanitize runs last, so a replacement cannot inject '/'.

Preview card (on the node, every load): SOURCE with the match highlighted, PATTERN, MATCHED, RESULT.

Toggle matrix: sanitize ON/emoji ON -> control + : / \ " <> | * + emoji removed, leading/trailing . and spaces trimmed. sanitize ON/emoji OFF -> control/path/reserved removed, emoji kept. sanitize OFF/emoji OFF -> raw name. Each toggle is in IS_CHANGED, so flipping re-runs the node.
